tool_input.content:
import urllib.request
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import re

feeds = {
    "VentureBeat AI": "https://venturebeat.com/category/ai/feed/",
    "TechCrunch AI": "https://techcrunch.com/category/artificial-intelligence/feed/",
    "Google News AI": "https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=artificial+intelligence&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en",
    "AI News": "https://www.artificialintelligence-news.com/feed/"
}

all_items = []

for source, url in feeds.items():
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
            data = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        # Strip CDATA and namespaces for cleaner parsing
        data = re.sub(r'<!\[CDATA\[(.*?)\]\]>', r'\1', data, flags=re.DOTALL)
        root = ET.fromstring(data)
        channel = root.find("channel")
        items = channel.findall("item") if channel else []
        for item in items[:8]:
            title = (item.findtext("title") or "").strip()
            desc = (item.findtext("description") or "").strip()
            desc = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', desc)[:300]
            pub = (item.findtext("pubDate") or "").strip()
            link = (item.findtext("link") or "").strip()
            if title:
                all_items.append({
                    "source": source,
                    "title": title,
                    "desc": desc,
                    "pub": pub,
                    "link": link
                })
        print(f"[OK] {source}: fetched {len(items[:8])} items")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[ERR] {source}: {e}")

print("\n========== ALL ARTICLES ==========\n")
for i, it in enumerate(all_items, 1):
    print(f"[{i}] [{it['source']}] {it['title']}")
    print(f"     Date: {it['pub']}")
    print(f"     Desc: {it['desc'][:250]}")
    print(f"     Link: {it['link']}")
    print()
